intent: Six original OpenWire icon concept explorations

concepts.label: 1 — Open ring
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one standalone OpenWire news aggregator app icon, square raster export. Create an original, highly polished professional identity, flat vector-like precision with crisp geometric contours. Full-bleed square background, no external border or rounded-corner frame (operating systems apply their own masks). The symbol must be optically centered at the exact center of the canvas with balanced visual mass and equal breathing room; keep all symbol pixels inside the central 60 percent of the square for app-mask safety. Visually bold and recognizable at 32px. No words, no labels, no numbering, no watermark, no mockup, no perspective, no gradients, no shadows, no bevels, no texture. Render only one icon filling the square.
Subject: a white architectural open O ring with one horizontal wire crossing its interior toward the opening. One clean circular stroke and one disciplined horizontal line, no extra headline lines. The line end stays within the total mark bounds and the entire combined silhouette is centered, rather than centering only the ring. Balanced professional letterform, assertive proportions, precise restrained rounded terminals. Color palette: white symbol on solid emerald #079A72.
